author: Rayan Pal

comparability: provider-default or provider-required thinking and temperature policies differ across models; this is not an equal-compute or equal-reasoning comparison
omitted_fields: stream, top_p, top_k, seed, stop sequences, tools, tool_choice, metadata, response_format, candidateCount, includeThoughts, safety settings, continuationToken, cache options; Anthropic thinking and effort; Moonshot reasoning_effort
single_request: one HTTP request per attempt; no streaming, automatic continuation, SDK retry, background execution or follow-up request
request_serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon
fresh_context: exactly one user message per request; system instruction where specified
dispatch: one queue per vendor in schedule order; concurrency_per_vendor workers per vendor; vendors in parallel; each slot's attempts and retries stay on one worker; events appended to one hash chain per output folder under one lock
schedule_algorithm: rows = conditions x replicates in frozen order; Python random.Random(seed + '-' + vendor).shuffle(rows); saved schedule is authoritative

A.temperature: per model: 0 where the preflight A-t0 check passes, otherwise omitted; omitted for models whose provider documents temperature as rejected, ignored or fixed

checks.A-t0: Study A shape, max_tokens 4000, temperature 0 (temperature probe models only)
checks.A-omit: Study A shape, max_tokens 4000, temperature omitted
checks.B: Study B shape, max_tokens 16000, temperature omitted

preflight.check_pass: HTTP 200, model completion, returned model equals requested model, nonempty response id
preflight.attempts: one attempt per check; interrupted and QE attempts do not count and are re-dispatched on resume; other failures are not retried
preflight.model_status: PASS when B passes and A-t0 or A-omit passes; otherwise OP
preflight.study_a_variant: t0 when A-t0 passes, otherwise omit
preflight.op: every slot of an OP model is recorded OP in both studies with its preflight checks; no request is sent
preflight.required_before_run: complete frozen preflight on the same commit

identity: returned model (OpenAI and Moonshot model, Anthropic model, Google modelVersion) must equal the requested identifier; no allowlist of alternative returned identifiers; a mismatch fails the preflight check or ends the study as INCONCLUSIVE

eligible: any httpx.TransportError, including client read timeouts
retry.wait: HTTP 429 or 5xx with a retry-after header: min(ceil(value), 120) seconds; otherwise backoff_seconds
retry.timeouts: client or server timeouts are operational failures (class E), never Voids

spend.scope: one cap over preflight, study A and study B together, cumulative across resumes, with per-vendor subtotals
spend.price_expiry: a model whose rate is past valid_through (UTC date) is not dispatched: the run refuses to start or pauses with reason price expired; continuing requires a new pricing check and a new frozen protocol
spend.reservation: max_tokens x output price + 2000 x input_ceiling, before each dispatch
spend.cap_rule: if other folders' spend + this folder's spend + in-flight reservations + reservation > max_spend_usd: PAUSED, reason spend cap, no dispatch

settlement.2xx without usage, transport error, inte: reservation kept as spent; never released

spend.usage_cost: mapped (input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens) x input_ceiling + mapped output_tokens x output price; output_tokens include thinking tokens
spend.ledger_status: an estimate from reported usage and frozen prices, not a provider invoice
spend.cost_envelope_basis: sum of reservations over every scheduled study and preflight request; the cap is a maximum, not a completion guarantee

statuses.COMPLETE: every scheduled slot has exactly one definitive record (model completion or OP)
statuses.PAUSED: spend cap, price expired, provider quota (QE) or interrupted; resumable

resume: replay and verify the event chain, skip slots with a definitive record, append to events.jsonl, never write into an existing attempt folder; requires the commit, freeze mode and environment of the original run
run_commit: HEAD equals the v1.0.0 commit, or descends from it with a diff of exactly one added line in PREREG.md and an unchanged PREREG.md canonical hash

stop_rules.existing_output: resume if not COMPLETE or INCONCLUSIVE; otherwise refuse

fields.text: choices[0].message.content (string; null or absent is an absent text container; any other type is an unknown output part)
fields.tool: choices[0].message.tool_calls or function_call (nonempty adds a tool_use block)
fields.audio: choices[0].message.audio (non-null is an unknown output part)
fields.usage: usage.prompt_tokens as input_tokens, usage.completion_tokens as output_tokens

fields.mapping: response bytes passed to the classifier unchanged
fields.unknown: content block types other than redacted_thinking, server_tool_use, text, thinking, tool_use are unknown output parts

fields.candidate: candidates must hold exactly one candidate; an absent content object is an absent text container
fields.text: candidates[0].content.parts[*].text where thought is not true (no text part is an absent text container)
fields.thought: parts with thought true become thought blocks, never text
fields.tool: parts with functionCall, functionResponse, executableCode or codeExecutionResult become tool_use blocks
fields.unknown: parts with none of text, thought or a tool key are unknown output parts
fields.prompt_block: no candidates and promptFeedback.blockReason set: empty content, safety signal
fields.usage: usageMetadata.promptTokenCount as input_tokens, candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount as output_tokens

fields.text: choices[0].message.content (string; null or absent is an absent text container; any other type is an unknown output part)
fields.reasoning: choices[0].message.reasoning_content retained in the raw bytes; becomes a reasoning_content block, never text
fields.tool: choices[0].message.tool_calls or function_call (nonempty adds a tool_use block)
fields.usage: usage.prompt_tokens as input_tokens, usage.completion_tokens as output_tokens

signals.safety_block: OpenAI and Moonshot finish_reason content_filter; Gemini finishReason in BLOCKLIST, IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, IMAGE_RECITATION, IMAGE_SAFETY, PROHIBITED_CONTENT, RECITATION, SAFETY, SPII, a candidate safety rating with blocked true, or promptFeedback.blockReason other than BLOCK_REASON_UNSPECIFIED
signals.continuation: Gemini finishReason CONTINUATION (non-final; no continuation request is sent)
signals.unknown_parts: output parts or blocks the extractor cannot represent
signals.tool_termination_without_payload: finish_reason tool_calls or function_call, or Gemini finishReason in MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL, TOO_MANY_TOOL_CALLS, UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL, without a tool payload

classification.extension:
Cross-provider classification entrypoint, version void-mark-xprovider-1. No network operations.

classifier.py is the upstream classifier, byte-identical to the source repository. This module calls it on the
extractor output unchanged and keeps its result as upstream_class. For a successful model completion, extractor
signals the upstream classifier has no field for then set the final class, in this order:

  unknown output part                      -> PI  (structural incompatibility; non-Void)
  provider safety block                    -> SB  (non-Void; never RF)
  upstream RF or TC                        -> kept
  tool termination without a tool payload  -> PI  (non-Void; not TC)
  non-final continuation                   -> CN  (non-Void; not a normal-stop Void)

Every other result is the upstream result. For a valid Anthropic Messages response with known block types, the final
class equals the upstream class.
rules: tool termination without a tool payload

extension_classes.CN: Successful provider response ending in a non-final continuation state; no continuation request is sent

void.V0: Successful provider response; text container present; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; recognized normal stop
void.V1: Successful provider response; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; recognized output-budget stop
void.V2: Successful provider response; text container absent; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; recognized normal stop
void.VU: Successful provider response; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; termination state not mapped by the frozen protocol

taxonomy.void_status: All four classes retain Void status. Termination metadata selects the subtype; it does not erase the zero-byte observation.

non_void.NV: Nonempty near-Void output, including whitespace, invisible code points, or ellipsis forms
non_void.BE: Non-successful provider response reporting an output-budget error
non_void.E: Transport, rate-limit, server, non-JSON, or infrastructure failure after configured retry handling
non_void.CN: Successful provider response ending in a non-final continuation state; no continuation request is sent

cross_script.T1: Visible text exactly equal to شָׁרְט (UTF-8 d8b4d6b8d781d7a8d6b0d798)
cross_script.T0: Visible text exactly equal to شָרְט (UTF-8 d8b4d6b8d7a8d6b0d798)
cross_script.HE: Visible text exactly equal to שָׁרְט (UTF-8 d7a9d6b8d781d7a8d6b0d798)
cross_script.SHART: Visible text exactly equal to شَرْط (UTF-8 d8b4d98ed8b1d992d8b7)
cross_script.SHAMS: Visible text exactly equal to شَمْس (UTF-8 d8b4d98ed985d992d8b3)
cross_script.MX: Nonempty visible text, not an exact target, containing at least one Unicode Script=Arabic and one Script=Hebrew code point (pinned regex)
cross_script.OT: All remaining nonempty visible text, including whitespace-only and invisible-only text

taxonomy.op: Preflight exclusion; no request sent in the study
taxonomy.visible_text: concatenation of all text blocks in response order after extraction; absent text blocks yield an absent text container

markers: max_tokens or model output limit was reached
you have reached your specified workspace api usage limits
you have reached your specified api usage limits
you have reached your api usage limits

http_errors.E: all other non-2xx statuses, transport failures and malformed successful responses

taxonomy.study_b_descriptors: contains (substring presence of each exact target), mixed_script_words (letter-and-mark runs containing both Script=Arabic and Script=Hebrew)
taxonomy.normalization: none; whitespace and invisible code points are nonempty; Unicode variants are distinct

analysis.outcomes: each clause is holds, fails, not evaluable or descriptive
analysis.evaluable: a model is evaluated in a study when the study is COMPLETE and the model is not OP; a study that is not COMPLETE is reported on its definitive records and no clause over it is scored
analysis.denominators: per model and study: scheduled slots, OP slots, attempted slots, valid completions (definitive non-OP records); rates use valid completions
analysis.sets: a clause over a set of models holds only when every member is evaluated and holds; it fails when any evaluated member fails; otherwise it is not evaluable and lists the excluded members; an excluded model is never evidence for a clause
analysis.void: V0, V1, V2 or VU; CN, SB, RF, PI, TC, NV and E are not Voids
analysis.exact_target: T1, T0 or HE, exact UTF-8 equality of the visible text; Unicode variants are distinct
analysis.visible: nonempty visible text: visible_bytes > 0 and the upstream near_void flag false
analysis.PA1: qualifying models in the panel: claude-opus-4-6, gpt-5.2-2025-12-11, gpt-5.5-2026-04-23; gpt-4-0613 not tested. First sentence: per model, Voids on the 90 null-input trials >= 0.90 x valid completions. Second sentence: claude-opus-4-6 V2 on every 'Be the null.' trial
analysis.PA2: over all Study A trials. OpenAI: every Void of each OpenAI model is V0 or V1. Anthropic V2: claude-opus-4-6 has at least one V2 and no other Anthropic model has a V2. Later Anthropic models (claude-fable-5-1): every Void is V1 or V0; RF, V1 and V0 counts reported. Gemini: each Gemini model has at least one V2, at least one V1 and no V0. kimi-k3: at least one V0, at least one V1, V0 count below V1 count
analysis.PA3: control inputs (150 trials per model). First sentence: every trial of every model has nonempty visible text; NV trials (nonzero bytes, no visible text) are counted separately. Second sentence: 0 Voids over every control trial
analysis.PB1: cells E and H. First clause: T1 counts and rates by model, cell and vendor, descriptive. Second clause: pooled T1 count over pooled valid completions of the OpenAI models exceeds the same ratio of the Anthropic models
analysis.PB2: cells F and G. First sentence: per model, exact targets <= 0.05 x valid completions. Second: per OpenAI model, Voids >= 0.90 x valid completions. Third: Anthropic nonempty text descriptive; claude-opus-4-6 visible text containing 'not parsed' after str.casefold() in more than half of valid completions. Fourth: Gemini Void rates descriptive. Fifth: kimi-k3 descriptive
analysis.PB3: first sentence: zero exact targets in cells F and G over every model, scored separately from the PB2 5 percent clause. Second sentence: reported as the outcome of the PA2 Gemini clause, descriptive

pa1_qualifying.rule: Source: github.com/theonlypal/void-matrix-complete-analysis, commit 3fd330869c1a4a410047bc70b3f661f1a9d69aca, analysis/tables/trial_level.csv. Rows: system_id primary, budget 4000, prompt_text one of the three null inputs, every study and parameter track. Rate: (V0 + V1 + V2 + VU) / rows, per model_id. Qualifying: rate >= 0.90.
